title: Mereimar bar Chanina

paragraphs: In the time of Rava ([Bava Metzia 97a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.97a.11)): he hired out a mule [to the people of] Bei Chozai; he went out to help lift its load together with them; they were negligent with it and it died; they came before Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage says initially that the owner went out to lift the load. Its ending explains that he went out to watch the load. Hyman abbreviates the account. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2553&lang=en) cites the same episode.
